short.text: Ryan Davis earned the fourth edge-rusher job in Jacksonville's 2013 rotation with his rush finishes in the preseason, and he dressed for {{2013.regular.games}} regular-season games and both playoff games. The staff saw a developmental situational pass rusher with a useful first step, edge speed and pursuit. His edge anchor against the run and his ability to defeat blocks needed to catch up to that movement.

transactions.text: Signed a reserve/future contract with Jacksonville
Waived by Jacksonville at the reduction to 53
